title: Ada and the Inheritance
author: G. M. Marchetti
blurb: Jude Blackwood, a true-crime podcaster chasing the coldest case on record, prides themselves on never taking a case they can't close. Then the town's beloved founder is exhumed and the coffin is empty — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now he must trap a killer who knows the case file better than the investigators do, and time is already running out.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
